title: feed_handler: limit parameter accepts u64::MAX from client, silent truncation on arithmetic
description: feed.rs feed_handler: query.limit is an Option<u64>, capped at 500 via .min(500). However, effective_low is computed as effective_high.saturating_sub(limit.saturating_sub(1)).max(low) where limit is u64. If effective_high < limit, saturating_sub returns 0, then max(low) clamps to low — correct. But the query_range call then runs with effective_low=low and effective_high=effective_high, which may return up to (effective_high-low+1) records regardless of the 500 cap. The cap applies to limit but effective range is computed differently and may exceed limit when effective_high is set from the before cursor. Scenario: effective_high from before cursor lands 600 items from low; effective_low gets clamped by max(low), returning 600 items.
